scale_cues: Large stainless steel mixing bowl filling the frame (assumed ~28-30 cm rim diameter); grape tomatoes used as an internal size reference (~2.5-3 cm long, ~7-8 g each); chicken cube size judged relative to the tomatoes.
assumptions: Bowl is a standard ~28-30 cm mixing bowl; no cutlery or hand in frame for direct scale
About 11 grape tomatoes at ~7-8 g each
Roughly 30-35 chicken pieces in a partly stacked pile, averaging ~3-4 g each
Chicken is skinless breast meat with light browning from grilling/roasting; no visible sauce, dressing or pooled oil, so no added fat itemised
Light seasoning specks on the chicken weigh under 1 g and are not listed separately
